# ConnectedAnimation

Header: `winui/ui/ConnectedAnimation.hpp`.

A connected animation: one element flying from where it was (the source, snapshotted by [ConnectedAnimationService::prepare_to_animate()](#prepare_to_animate)) to where its counterpart is (the destination, named by [try_start()](#try_start)), usually across a page navigation.

The service owns it, and you reach it by reference or pointer. It lives until it completes or is canceled. One that is never started times out two seconds after being prepared. While it runs, a crossfade of the two snapshots moves from the source's rect to the destination's, and by default scales with it. It is drawn above the tree and below popups. The destination stays hidden until the flight lands.

Example: 
```cpp
// On the list page, just before navigating away:
void leave_list(ui::ImageControl& thumbnail)
{
    window.connected_animation_service().prepare_to_animate("ForwardConnectedAnimation", thumbnail);
}

// On the detail page, once its tree is in the window:
void arrive_at_detail(ui::ImageControl& detail_image, ui::TextControl& detail_title)
{
    ui::ConnectedAnimationService& service = window.connected_animation_service();
    if (ui::ConnectedAnimation* animation = service.animation("ForwardConnectedAnimation"))
    {
        animation->set_flight_path(ui::ShortFlightPath{});
        animation->on_completed([] { /* the destination is showing again */ });
        animation->try_start(detail_image, {&detail_title}); // the title flies in alongside
    }
}
```

### ConnectedAnimation

```cpp
ConnectedAnimation(const ConnectedAnimation&) = delete
```

Non-copyable: the service owns every animation.

### operator=

```cpp
ConnectedAnimation& operator=(const ConnectedAnimation&) = delete
```

Non-copyable: the service owns every animation.

### try_start

```cpp
bool try_start(Element& destination, std::vector<Element*> coordinated = {})
```

Animate into `destination`, and fly the `coordinated` elements in alongside it. They start from where they would sit relative to the source and fade in. The flight begins after the next layout, when the destination is snapshotted and hidden. Returns false and does nothing when the animation was already started, canceled or timed out, or when the destination is the source itself. A destination destroyed before that layout, or laid out with zero size, cancels the animation.

### cancel

```cpp
void cancel()
```

Drop it, snapshot and all; a hidden destination shows again.

### flight_path

```cpp
const std::optional<FlightPath>& flight_path() const
```

The flight path; nullopt (the default) is an [ArcFlightPath](#struct-arcflightpath).

### set_flight_path

```cpp
void set_flight_path(std::optional<FlightPath> path)
```

Set before [try_start()](#try_start); a running flight keeps the path it began with.

### is_scale_animation_enabled

```cpp
bool is_scale_animation_enabled() const
```

True (the default) scales the snapshots from the source's size to the destination's. False keeps their own sizes, so they only move, centered on each other.

### set_scale_animation_enabled

```cpp
void set_scale_animation_enabled(bool enabled)
```

Set before [try_start()](#try_start).

### on_completed

```cpp
void on_completed(Callback<void()> handler)
```

Fired when the animation has played (not when it is canceled or times out). Replaces any previous handler.


The current state; Prepared right after prepare_to_animate().

## class ConnectedAnimationService

The per-window registry of connected animations, keyed by name, and the layer that draws them.

Each [Window](window.md) owns one ([Window::connected_animation_service()](window.md#connected_animation_service)) and runs and draws its animations. An app only prepares animations and looks them up. Keys are strings the app chooses, and both pages use the same key.

Example: 
```cpp
// On the list page, just before navigating away:
void leave_list(ui::ImageControl& thumbnail)
{
    window.connected_animation_service().prepare_to_animate("ForwardConnectedAnimation", thumbnail);
}

// On the detail page, once its tree is in the window:
void arrive_at_detail(ui::ImageControl& detail_image, ui::TextControl& detail_title)
{
    ui::ConnectedAnimationService& service = window.connected_animation_service();
    if (ui::ConnectedAnimation* animation = service.animation("ForwardConnectedAnimation"))
    {
        animation->set_flight_path(ui::ShortFlightPath{});
        animation->on_completed([] { /* the destination is showing again */ });
        animation->try_start(detail_image, {&detail_title}); // the title flies in alongside
    }
}
```

### prepare_to_animate

```cpp
ConnectedAnimation& prepare_to_animate(std::string key, Element& source)
```

Snapshot `source` now, under `key`, and cancel any animation already prepared under it. The returned animation lives until it completes, is canceled or times out, and [animation()](#animation) finds it until then.

### animation

```cpp
ConnectedAnimation* animation(const std::string& key) const
```

The animation prepared under `key` and not yet finished, or nullptr.

## struct StraightFlightPath

A straight move with the service's default duration and easing ([ConnectedAnimationService::default_duration()](#default_duration), default_easing()).

## struct ShortFlightPath

A straight, decelerating 200 ms move with (0.1,0.9)-(0.2,1) easing. Use it for back navigation.

## struct ArcFlightPath

The default flight path. The element dips 80 DIPs downward and back during a 300 ms move with (0.8,0)-(0.2,1) cubic Bézier easing. When its size does not otherwise change, it scales up by 10 % at the lowest point.

Example: 
```cpp
void prepare_flight(ui::Element& source)
{
    ui::ConnectedAnimation& animation =
        window.connected_animation_service().prepare_to_animate("ForwardConnectedAnimation", source);
    animation.set_flight_path(ui::ArcFlightPath{.shadow = false});
}
```

| Field | Type | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `shadow` | `bool` | `true` | A shadow under the element as it flies. |

## Enumerations

### ConnectedAnimationState

```cpp
enum class ConnectedAnimationState
```

The stage a [ConnectedAnimation](#uiconnectedanimation) is in.

| Value | |
| --- | --- |
| `Prepared` | snapshot taken, waiting for try_start() |
| `Started` | try_start() called, waiting for the destination's layout |
| `Running` | flying; the destination is hidden |
| `Complete` | played to the end; on_completed() has fired |
| `Canceled` | cancel()ed, replaced by a new prepare, or timed out |
